authority: This file maps the already recorded RideX service/vehicle decisions. Backend remains authoritative for service validation, vehicle eligibility, price and booking state. It does not itself alter runtime behavior.

eventRide.mappingNote: EVENT_RIDE is used as the eligibility/availability discriminator; persisted Booking.rideType uses the Prisma RideType enum CITY_RIDE and keeps EVENT_RIDE in serviceSubtype.

observedSourceMappings.bookingRoute: services/backend/src/routes/bookings.ts accepts RIDE/GOODS and CITY_RIDE/SHARING_RIDE/INTERCITY_RIDE; permits the two logistic parcel variants; checks CARGO_DELIVERY eligibility.
observedSourceMappings.eventRoute: services/backend/src/routes/events.ts calls availability with serviceType EVENT and rideType EVENT_RIDE, then persists bookingType RIDE, rideType CITY_RIDE, serviceSubtype EVENT_RIDE and passengerCount.
observedSourceMappings.mobileCatalog: apps/ridex-mobile/shared/vehicleCatalog.ts filters passenger vehicles by the two passenger category codes and cargo vehicles by CARGO_DELIVERY; event options are also limited by server-returned availability.

pendingEndToEndChecks: Cross-check all canonical fields through customer mobile request -> Backend validation -> matching -> persisted Booking -> Driver/Admin views.
Verify category catalogue records in the approved local database and confirm that active vehicle entries carry the expected eligibility attributes.
Validate Full Ride passenger-count omission, Share/Connection/Event passenger-count requirements, and Parcel/Goods cargo specifications during final physical/E2E phase.

Review mutation authorization for service enablement toggles: the matching-configuration PUT currently uses the broad operational configuration permission; confirm the intended Admin/Super Admin authority before final runtime sign-off.

disableEffects: Block new quote, availability, booking, matching and dispatch for the disabled service.
Do not automatically cancel already-active trips when a service is disabled.
Enforce service enablement in Backend eligibility and booking handlers; client-side hiding/filtering is advisory only.
serviceEnablementPolicy.eventEnforcementRequirement: EVENT must have an independently enforced service switch; it must not accidentally inherit only passengerEnabled because persisted Event bookings may be represented as RIDE/CITY_RIDE plus EVENT_RIDE subtype.

mutationAuthorityReview.observedGuard: Super Admin may change Passenger/Shared/Parcel/Goods/Event enablement; operational Admin may tune unrelated matching fields but receives 403 if any service-availability toggle actually changes.
mutationAuthorityReview.securityReason: The previous broad operational configuration permission could change service availability while the role decision was pending; fail-closed default restricts this high-impact toggle to Super Admin.
